title: Reprojection-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting Diffusion for Weakly Supervised Single-Image Normal Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2508.05950v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose CLONE, a Continuous Latent Optimization framework for Normal Estimation via 3D Gaussian splatting. The core idea is to construct an image-geometry-image consistency strategy that unifies explicit geometric representation with differentiable rendering, thereby enabling weakly supervised learning without normal ground truth. Specifically, CLONE comprises four components. First, by introducing a differentiable light interaction model with a learnable modulation kernel, we perform a unified reparameterization of the 3DGS parameter space. Second, the conditional single-step deterministic refinement network integrates denoising architectures with differentiable reprojection constraints to refine the initial normals, thereby adaptively recovering the high-frequency details erased by the inherently smooth Gaussian primitives. translated_title: 重投影引导的3D高斯溅射扩散用于弱监督单图像法线估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.05950v4 公告类型：跨版本替换 摘要：我们提出了CLONE，一种通过3D高斯溅射进行法线估计的连续潜在优化框架。核心思想是构建一个图像-几何-图像一致性策略，将显式几何表示与可微渲染统一起来，从而在没有法线真值的情况下实现弱监督学习。具体而言，CLONE包含四个组成部分。首先，通过引入带有可学习调制核的可微光交互模型，我们对3DGS参数空间进行统一重参数化。其次，条件单步确定性精化网络将去噪架构与可微重投影约束相结合，以精化初始法线，从而自适应地恢复由固有平滑的高斯原语抹去的高频细节。第三，跨域门控融合机制自适应地结合两种互补的法线估计。
tldr: 本文提出CLONE框架，通过3D高斯溅射与可微渲染的统一，实现无需法线真值的弱监督单图像法线估计，并利用重投影约束和跨域融合提升高频细节恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CLONE, a framework that unifies 3D Gaussian splatting with differentiable rendering for weakly supervised single-image normal estimation without ground truth, enhancing high-frequency detail recovery via reprojection constraints and cross-domain fusion.
